start_here: Say to your AI: "Check my computer at 203.0.113.20 from outside; its row opens 22, 80 and 443." It runs tool:check-a-computer-from-outside and tells you every port, certificate or domain that differs from what the row declares.
no_lists_because: It keeps nothing: it reads what any scanner on the internet can see of one computer and answers it, with the differences from the ports and names the caller gives.
instructions: 1. Read the computer's row from wherever you keep it: its public address, the ports it declares open (such as 22/tcp) and the names its sites serve.
2. Call tools:run with tool tool:check-a-computer-from-outside and input {name, address, declared_ports, names}.

3. Read findings: an open port the row does not declare, a declared port that does not answer, a certificate or domain close to its end. Fix each through the computer's row, never by hand on the computer.
4. To check every computer and tell each finding as a fact other workflows hear, run workflow:check-every-computer-from-outside.
